$comment: Target groups registry. ONE post per group per run.
posting_code = the name of the Python function implementing THAT group's flow
(poster/flows.py::<posting_code>). One function per group; unknown code = hard error, no guessing.
photos_order: 'sorted' = car subfolders of data/car_photos in name order (NN_ prefixes).
Optional 'recording': ap-record dump dir this flow was built from (auto-detected from .local-capture when omitted).
Index of states is computed by `poetry run python -m poster.main --status` (alias: ap-status).
